Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: broaden.

**What the vignettes add.** The record covers temptation and replacement. The vignettes add what happens afterward and why: agents make text "too long and too generic" (bbd0b6e3); "Once an AI has written all the text, it's actually very hard to claim control back" (24c38533); a small change request ends up with "an unrecognisable document" (ac97a191); it is easy to get caught in flow and let AI own the words (47379410); the owner's own account: "I let the AI own the wrong parts. I was not in charge of myself" (d6d480b2) and cognitive debt (the words are not properly mine); and a wider frame, autonomy lost gradually, "the gradual, sweet usurpation of autonomy" (2ad7e527), with every tool wanting to write for us (1cf3ef4f). Desired shape: AI as a peer with creativity but not the final words (af4b7e6c).

**Proposed.** When an agent can draft for me I let it, and then the text is long, generic and not mine: I do not recognise it, and it is very hard to take control back. I want AI to respond to my writing as a peer, with its creativity, while I keep the final words.

**Depth.** Deep: 11 vignettes, including first-person owner experience, recurring across editor sessions through 2026-11-06.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
